datasets.modifications: Source prepared approximate country centroids and artificial placeholder rates/intervals for software demonstrations. Atlas preserves the original GeoJSON bytes and provides two exact filename aliases used by the source notebook.

datasets.title: JASL/UHSLC hourly sea-level observations: Lagos 2333/C and Mombasa 1011/A, 1–28 July 1994
datasets.credit: Caldwell, Patrick C.; Merrifield, Mark A.; Thompson, Philip R. (2001). Sea level measured by tide gauges from global oceans as part of the Joint Archive for Sea Level (JASL) since 1846. Subset: UHSLC hourly records 2333 (Lagos C) and 1011 (Mombasa A), 1994-07-01 to 1994-07-28 UTC. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. Dataset. https://doi.org/10.7289/V5V40S7W. Accessed 2026-11-13 via UHSLC ERDDAP. Primary [NOAA metadata](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/metadata/landing-page/bin/iso?id=gov.noaa.nodc%3AJIMAR-JASL); [UHSLC hourly archive](https://uhslc.soest.hawaii.edu/erddap/tabledap/global_hourly_rqds.html).
datasets.rights: The source [ERDDAP license metadata](https://jltobias.github.io/JupyterLite-Learning-Atlas/data/uhslc-hourly-metadata.csv) explicitly permits free use and redistribution. Its complete accuracy/warranty/liability statement is retained. No CreativeCommons license is invented; cite JASL/UHSLC, NOAA NCEI and the exact subset. The separate SouthAfrican SANHO restrictions do not describe these Nigerian/Kenyan records.
datasets.modifications: Two complete 672-hour windows extracted with raw millimetres, UTC timestamps, station/record versions, source coordinates and response hashes retained. Display anomalies subtract each record’s valid 28-day mean, divide by 1000 and round to 6 decimals; no interpolation. Original full-field source CSVs and metadata accompany the derived JSON.
datasets.additional_notice: Station zero and a short-window mean are not long-term MSL. These historical observations are a separate chart/marker, not a terrain offset, king tide classification, current forecast or revised facility-risk model. Gauge record versions are not joined.

introduction: This register identifies the data actually bundled with the expanded source courses. Exact source-file hashes, local placements, source commits and retained notices are in [the source-library manifest](https://jltobias.github.io/JupyterLite-Learning-Atlas/catalog/source-library.json). The source snapshots retain their own credits and rights; a project software license does not relicense provider data. Atlas import changes are recorded per notebook. No agency or producer endorsement is implied.
notes: **AR6 acknowledgement:** We acknowledge the projection authors and supporting funding agencies, and the NASA Sea Level Change Team for developing and hosting the IPCC AR6 Sea Level Projection Tool. Complete supplied citations and acknowledgement remain with the course license notice.

**Underlying SeasFire variables:** [ERA5](https://doi.org/10.24381/cds.adbb2d47), [MODIS MOD13C1v6](https://doi.org/10.5067/MODIS/MOD13C1.006), and [JRC/GWIS](https://gwis.jrc.ec.europa.eu/) retain their producer identification; a selected cube variable is not a direct local health observation.

**Original teaching fixtures and factual registries:** James L. Tobias and the named source-course contributors (2026); source-specific deterministic arrays, conceptual grids, simulated health/facility records and original curated capability/initiative/catalog registries. Preserve synthetic, placeholder and metadata-only labels. Their source license or owner-authorized reuse scope is shown in each course guide; no third-party dataset grant is inferred from a familiar place name.

**Excluded or external inputs:** restricted GADM; unclear historical images, PDFs, music and screenshots; the17 rights-unclear climate legacy notebooks; undocumented South Sudan inputs; preliminary epidemiological inputs requiring extra permission; legacy WHO/IMF inputs without a suitable item-specific open grant; raw controlled data and unverified source outputs. Exclusions name exact source paths/reasons and the effect on affected lessons. Linked resources retain their creators’ rights. Copyright and license notices needed by retained open material are preserved.

**Optional live inputs:** source notebooks retain their provider/product citations and query instructions for OpenStreetMap/Overpass and tile services, USGS earthquake feeds, NASA GIBS, Copernicus, WorldPop, GeoLibre hosted samples, Major TOM, ESA WorldCover, CHIRPS and other named gateways. These are external continuations, not silently mirrored data or a blanket license to download every provider asset. Preserve the selected product’s own citation and terms when running such a branch.
